q: What is the difference between idli and dosa?
a: Idli and dosa both use fermented rice and urad dal batter, but idli is steamed into soft, round cakes while dosa is spread thin and cooked on a griddle until crisp or soft. Idli is lighter and milder; dosa offers more variety. Brihadhee in Anna Nagar serves both, and the menu page lists each.

q: What is the difference between kothu parotta and paanai parotta?
a: Paanai parotta is a layered parotta usually served as a whole piece with gravy, while kothu parotta is parotta shredded and stir-fried on a hot griddle with spices, vegetables and gravy. One is soft and flaky to tear and dip; the other is mixed and hearty. Brihadhee in Anna Nagar lists both as vegetarian dishes.
